why: rc17: rc16 fixes + every real name in the spell and talent texts marked

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc17 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: zone headers in the quest list no longer flip between Persian, empty boxes and English.
Fix: the world-map hover label with a level range ('Hillsbrad Foothills (20-30)') is Persian.
Fix: the quest tracker no longer turns itself off on the modern client, so quest titles and objective lines in the quest list are Persian.
Fix: every marked name is coloured: classes (also 'the hunter', 'Hunters', talent trees), game terms (cyan), items (gold) and objects (purple) got default colours.
Data: 131 more class / spell / term / zone names marked in spell and talent descriptions (school words like 'fire damage' stay plain on purpose).
Includes rc7 to rc16.

Data from ForeverDB.net
